response:
It sounds frustrating to reach out for support and be met with silence, especially when you've taken a meaningful step in deciding to return to counseling.

A few things might explain the delay: many providers don't check messages over weekends, so a "24 hour" turnaround may mean business days. He could also be out of the office, or no longer taking clients. If you don't hear back within a few business days, it's reasonable to call again or send a follow-up. That said, therapists aren't obligated to resume a past relationship, and he may or may not have availability—but he should let you know either way once he receives your message.

If waiting feels difficult, it might help to look into a couple of other counselors as backup, so your decision to seek support doesn't hinge on one person's response. You deserve care, and there are options available to you.
